title: Grilled Chicken with Tuscan Potatoes, Buttered Vegetables & Chicken Jus
description: A classic Continental main course featuring herb-marinated grilled chicken served with crispy Tuscan potatoes, buttered seasonal vegetables, and a rich chicken jus.

ingredients.title: For the Grilled Chicken
items: Salt & freshly ground pepper – to taste

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Grilled Chicken
steps: In a bowl, mix olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, paprika, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Marinate chicken for at least 2 hours (or overnight for best flavor).
Preheat a grill pan or charcoal grill.
Grill chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden, char-marked, and the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes before plating.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Tuscan Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender; drain well.
In a skillet, heat olive oil and butter, add garlic and rosemary.
Add potatoes, season, and sauté until golden and crisp.
Sprinkle chili flakes for a subtle kick.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Buttered Vegetables
steps: Blanch vegetables in salted boiling water until just tender.
Refresh in ice water to retain color.
Toss in butter, season, and finish with lemon juice just before serving.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Prepare the Chicken Jus
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in butter until golden.
Add thyme and deglaze with red wine (if using).
Add chicken stock and simmer until reduced by half.
Strain and finish with a knob of cold butter for sheen and richness.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating & Presentation
steps: Spoon a bed of Tuscan potatoes slightly off-center.
Slice grilled chicken on a bias and fan it neatly beside the potatoes.
Arrange buttered vegetables in a line or cluster for color balance.
Drizzle chicken jus elegantly around or under the chicken slices.
Finish with microgreens or a sprig of thyme, and a light drizzle of olive oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as a complete Continental main course.
Pair with crusty bread or a light green salad.
Enjoy with a glass of dry white wine or light red wine.

chefTips: For a smoky note, grill over charcoal instead of a grill pan.
Keep the jus glossy by whisking in cold butter just before service (classic monter au beurre technique).
Always rest grilled meats to retain juices.
